extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, pre-settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Lockwood Legal enquires about £40,500 to fund a wife's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £404,500 and the other side controls the liquid assets.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction of the proceedings, the stage reached and any listed hearing dates, and a breakdown of the assets in dispute with supporting documentation. We would also need your client's details, a costs estimate to settlement or trial, and confirmation of who controls the liquid assets. Once we have that information our team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding.
